failed_hypotheses.summary: An uncertain probe (hang / timeout / no key / unreachable) re-stamps the lane depleted on the default TTL, on the assumption the lane is still limited
failed_hypotheses.why_failed: The sweep only ever probes lanes that are already dark, so each uncertain probe reset the clock on a lane whose darkness had already expired: 27 re-stamps in one day, ~46 minutes apart, off a 429 that had reset eleven days earlier. Uncertain was treated as evidence of a limit; it is evidence of nothing.

failed_hypotheses.summary: Fix the lane by editing /etc/systemd/system/ht-allowance-watch.service on the box
failed_hypotheses.why_failed: Leaves production state outside version control: nothing records it, nothing re-applies it after a reimage, and the next reader cannot tell a hand-edit from a deploy. The user's requirement was the opposite (persistent, implemented in the repo).
failed_hypotheses.signature: unit authored on the host, then daemon-reload + restart

failed_hypotheses.summary: Reuse the unit's PATH to find the `cline` binary
failed_hypotheses.why_failed: The unit PATH has no ~/.npm-global/bin, where the CLI actually is, so the probe never ran and every sweep stayed uncertain — the watcher called Cline 'not installed' while the bot, resolving absolutely, called it ready.
